meta.title: Statement of Work
meta.subtitle: Prepared by BigStep Technologies for Acme Retail Pvt. Ltd. — Loyalty Platform, Phase 1.

blocks.text: BigStep Technologies will design and build a customer loyalty platform for Acme Retail, covering a customer-facing mobile app, an admin web console, and the supporting backend and data services. This SOW defines the scope, deliverables, timeline, commercials, and assumptions for Phase 1.

items: Customer mobile app (React Native + Expo): signup, points wallet, rewards catalogue, redemption.
Admin web console (React 19 + MUI): campaign setup, member management, reporting.
Backend services (Express 5 + TypeScript, DDD): auth, points ledger, rewards, notifications.
PostgreSQL data model via Kysely with reversible migrations.

rows: Passes UAT on the agreed device matrix; store-ready builds.
All campaign + reporting flows pass acceptance tests.
Reversible migrations; seed + backfill verified in staging.
Architecture, CI/CD, data model, auth skeleton.

blocks.title: Fixed price
body: Phase 1 fixed fee: as per the accompanying commercial proposal.
Billing: 30% advance, 40% at M2, 30% at M4 acceptance.

items: Client provides brand assets, content, and timely UAT feedback (≤ 3 business days per cycle).
Third-party services (SMS, email, push) are licensed by the client.
Scope changes are handled via a written change order.
